# pvecli sdn discard

Drop every pending SDN change, back to the applied configuration.

```text
pvecli sdn discard [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
